questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Rhea is putting up an exhibition on the silk routes and wants to show that goods and ideas moved along them together. Consider the following statements. 1. Buddhism, which emerged from eastern India, spread in several directions through intersecting points on the silk routes. 2. Christian missionaries and early Muslim preachers travelled these same routes, and trade and cultural exchange always went hand in hand. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Niall is explaining to his class why so many people left Ireland in the 1840s, and wants to give them the correct reason for it. Consider the following statements. 1. Ireland's poorest peasants became so dependent on potatoes that when disease destroyed the potato crop in the mid-1840s, hundreds of thousands died of starvation. 2. The disaster was caused by a disease that wiped out Ireland's maize crop, because maize had by then replaced the potato as the main food of the poor. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: The assertion is true but the reason is false.

questions.stem: Kabir is making a short film on how the world became more interconnected, and has asked his classmates to check his draft before he records it. Consider the following statements. 1. For centuries before European sailors found a sea route to Asia, the Indian Ocean carried no trade at all. 2. The Indian subcontinent lay outside the trading networks of the Indian Ocean, so goods and people never criss-crossed its waters. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are false.
